finding_key: packages/docs/src/model/types.ts::the new 'headinglevel is inert on a list-item' invariant is asserted in a comment but nothing tests it (export/serialize/clipboard readers)
evidence: Verified from the diff: every new test (packages/docs/test/view/list-heading-roundtrip.test.ts and the yorkie-doc-store.test.ts additions) asserts only type/headingLevel/list attrs on stores and Doc blocks; none feeds a list-item carrying headingLevel to any reader (markdown/docx/pdf export, blockStyleId, toolbar, clipboard). The design's safety explicitly rests on the "readers gate on type === 'heading'" invariant stated in the Block doc comment in packages/docs/src/model/types.ts, but nothing enforces it — a reader that stopped gating would pass all tests in this diff. Since the list-item+headingLevel state could not exist before this PR, pre-existing suite tests could not cover it. Confidence is medium because no checkout is mounted, so I could not inspect the reader files or the rest of the suite to fully rule out an existing test.
